text:
omar_marketing: Ok team — planning a small "Community Toolkit Demo Week" to push the new refapp + 3 short tutorials. Goal: drive OSS signups and collect 15 case-study leads. Thoughts?

liz_devrel: love it. cadence? one tutorial/day with a live demo + prerecorded refapp walkthroughs.

omar_marketing: thinking Tue-Fri next week. Tue: refapp intro, Wed: how to run benchmarks, Thu: customizing prompts, Fri: deploy + monitoring.

raj_product: +1. we should pin one clear CTA per day: repo star / submit a use-case / request demo. avoid asking for too much.

liz_devrel: agree on CTAs. also propose a short sample email to send to OSS list. draft below: 

```
Subject: Join our Community Toolkit Demo Week — build a refapp in 30 mins
Hi — we’re running a short demo week showcasing the Redwood refapp + tutorials. RSVP and get the code + a free consultation slot.
```

suzanne_design: I can prepare hero images + 3 800x450 tutorial thumbnails. Need final titles by EOD tomorrow.

michael_engineering: On the infra side, I’ll add a small demo cluster for the week (gpu-demo-1). Can we limit concurrent sessions to 10 to avoid spikes?

omar_marketing: yes, limit is fine. michael, add a quick status check Slack alert to #temp-alerts if queue > 8.

michael_engineering: will do. I’ll post the deploy link here when ready.

liz_devrel: content plan for each day: 1) quick 10m walkthrough, 2) 20m live build, 3) 15m Q&A. We’ll record and cut into clips for socials.

raj_product: we should surface one benchmark narrative mid-week: "cost drop with batching + quantized model" — short before/after numbers. marketing can use that as a hero stat.

omar_marketing: good call. liz, can you coordinate with SRE/ML for numbers? also we’ll need a 1-paragraph explainer for the blog.

liz_devrel: tagging @michael_engineering for the metrics and @suzanne_design for the stat visual. michael — can you export a simple chart (tokens/sec, cost/token) by Friday?

michael_engineering: yep. I’ll run the benchmark on gpu-demo-1 and push results to the drive. Slackbot will post the link.

postbot: Scheduled: Community Toolkit Demo Week — social posts queued for 2027-05-12 09:00 UTC.

omar_marketing: great. one last ask — inbound lead routing: if someone requests demo or support in the RSVP form, route to sales@redwood.ai and tag "refapp-demo" in HubSpot. Can someone add that to the form integration?

liz_devrel: I can update the form integration today. Will set up HubSpot mapping: email, company, use-case, repo link, demo_interest boolean.

raj_product: for messaging iteration, let’s A/B test two hero lines for the landing page: A) "Launch a refapp with Redwood in 30 minutes" B) "Production-ready inference — refapp + best practices". Will report conversion by Monday after the week.

omar_marketing: perfect. timeline checklist: EOD tomorrow — titles + thumbnails; Fri — benchmark draft; Mon — landing + registration live; Tue — Day 1. Everyone good?

suzanne_design: good from design side.

michael_engineering: good. I’ll post demo cluster link by EOD.

liz_devrel: got it. I’ll prep slides + code snippets and send to the #marketing-review channel for quick passes.

omar_marketing: thanks all :thumbsup: I’ll compile a public TODO and share.

liz_devrel: small note — for social clips, keep them under 45s. we’ll do 3 cuts per day.

raj_product: adding a follow-up play: collect highlight quotes for a post-demo case study. target 3 good stories.

omar_marketing: added to the sheet. closing thread for now — post updates as they happen.
